messages:
Ravi: Morning  ran a targeted onboarding + quant smoke for Navigator12b-int6 last night across 5 slices. I computed an EconCompassScore for quick prioritization.
Sofia: Cool  paste the topline?
Ravi: TL;DR then numbers. Short: big token savings, small average quality hit, but a localized regression on multi-document search/recall. Recommend hybrid route with a short GTN holdback + micro-evals.
Ravi: Metrics from nightly runner:
```
model: Navigator12b-int6
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.48
baseline_cost_per_1k (Navigator12b-fp16): $1.45
cost_savings_pct: 66.9%
overall_quality_delta: -0.9pp (chat-summaries + intent)
search_recall_delta: -3.4pp (multi-doc search slice)
hallucination_delta: +0.5pp (search slice)
p95_latency_short: 180ms
p95_latency_long_cold: 360ms
kv_cache_miss_rate_long: 19%
EconCompassScore: 0.79  # weighted(cost:0.5,quality:0.35,latency:0.15)
```
Mei: 0.79 is attractive for many UI flows. The search_recall -3.4pp and hallucination +0.5pp on that slice are concerning for legal/GTN. Any safety flags?
Ravi: No safety blockers in fuzz suite. We did see faithfulness dip aligned with the recall drop. Long-doc cold tails are driven by KV misses.
Sofia: For product: propose gating GTN/regulatory slices. Routing idea: flag `navigator.int6.hybrid` with default split 0.72 (non-critical) and holdbacks ["gtn_core","legal_search"]. Probe plan: 2% GTN sample after priming remediation + human micro-eval.
Mei: Fallback thresholds: auto-fallback to baseline if any holdback slice delta >1.25pp sustained for 12m OR if EconCompassScore < 0.72. Also alert if kv_cache_miss_rate_long > 18%.
Ravi: I'll run three remediation experiments today: (A) anchor-based priming variant, (B) explicit retrieval anchors + citation, (C) warmstart + prefix cache. Each run ~2k samples and I'll post quick diffs.
Sofia: Micro-eval plan: 250 GTN-critical prompts with human ratings; threshold <1.0pp gap to consider moving >5% GTN. Legal needs a tighter bar, hold until <0.6pp.
Mei: Ops: can you wire the routing flag + emergency fallback? Name it `navigator.hybrid.canary.2026-03-23` and add observability rule for KV miss rate and p95_long_cold increase >50ms over baseline.
ops-bot: bench-run completed: 1719998888 -> 1719998855. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/artifacts/1719998888. KV miss rate snapshot: 19%.
Ravi: Owners: Ravi (priming experiments & diffs), Mei (routing flag + infra fallback + alerts), Sofia (PM comms & micro-eval coordination).
Sofia: TL;DR for PMs: int6 cuts token cost ~67% vs fp16, small avg quality hit (~0.9pp), but multi-doc search recall regresses ~3.4pp. Recommend hybrid rollout with holdbacks, priming + cache mitigation, and micro-eval before shifting GTN/regulatory traffic.
Mei: I'll schedule the staging rollout for the routing flag tonight and wire the fallback.
Ravi: Thanks team  will post priming run diffs when ready. :thumbsup:
